networkAccess.reasoning: Figbridge talks only to a bridge the user runs on their own machine on http://localhost. The preferred port is 7331; if it's already in use (e.g. Claude Desktop respawned us while an older instance still holds the port), the bridge auto-falls-back to 7332..7340 and the plugin probes the same range to find it. Figma's manifest validator rejects bare IPs, so the list uses the `localhost` hostname only. No external servers are contacted; no design data ever leaves the user's device. The bridge is an open-source Node process the user installs themselves via `npx figbridge-mcp init`. If it is not running, the plugin still works as a local export/spec tool — it simply shows an offline state.
